name: Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc.
summary: Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc. is a global financial services company specializing in life insurance, with operations spanning Japan, the United States, and other international markets. The enterprise manages its activities through three primary divisions: Domestic Life Insurance, Overseas Insurance, and Other Businesses. Its diverse product suite includes individual life policies, various annuity options, non-participating single-premium whole life coverage, financial insurance solutions, and group annuities. Furthermore, the company extends its expertise to provide investment management products and services, catering to both individual and institutional investors. Founded in 1902, the entity was originally known as The Dai-Ichi Life Insurance Company, Limited, before rebranding to Dai-ichi Life Holdings, Inc. in October 2016. The company maintains its corporate headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
